title: Statutory homelessness: detailed local authority-level tables, January to March 2026 (sheet TA1)
publisher: MHCLG (Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government)
geography: Local authority (England, incl. 33 London boroughs E09)
definition_notes: TA1 col 'Households in TA Total' [note 34]: households in accommodation arranged by LAs pending enquiries or after acceptance as homeless under the 1996 Act (as amended by HRA 2017). Households in area (thousands) per note 5 (2022-based household projections). Suppression markers: [z] n/a, [x] missing, [c] suppressed.
notes: Direct file URL: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6a82ee2c92ec93e1e0329a7f/Statutory_Homelessness_Detailed_Local_Authority_Data_202603.ods. Sum of 33 boroughs (76017) differs by 3 from the London row (76020).

title: Live Table 600: households on local authority housing registers (waiting lists), by district
reference_period: 31 March each year 1987-2025 (2018 and earlier use 1 April until 2017-18 per note 3)
definition_notes: Households on LA housing registers, from LAHS Section C. Note 1: a register is not the same as households waiting; review frequency varies and households may be on several registers. Sheet used: Local_Authority_Data.
notes: Direct file URL: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6a2be263e50716856ed4afc4/Live_Table_600.ods. Last updated by MHCLG 25 June 2026.

title: Live Table 602: local authority owned dwellings let
definition_notes: LA-owned dwellings let. Only an England-level sheet was found, no Newham or borough rows.
notes: Direct file URL: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6a2be281c39255c595b507bc/Live_Table_602.ods. Downloaded and checked; not used for borough figures.

title: Social housing lettings in England, tenancies summary tables, April 2024 to March 2025 (Tables 1d and 1e used)
definition_notes: Table 1d: new social housing lettings (SR, AR, IR; general needs and supported; LA and PRP) by LA of property. Table 1e: social re-lets, average social vs market rent, stock at 1 April, churn. Counts come from CORE lettings returns.
notes: Direct file URL: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/69147610eba5bda2026fc827/Social_Housing_Lettings_in_England__Tenancies_Summary_Tables__2024-25.ods. Tenants summary tables and the sub-national dashboard not opened.

title: London boroughs code and name lookup (33 boroughs, E09000001 to E09000033)
publisher: Derived from MHCLG Live Table 600 (LAD24CD / LAD24NM columns, ONS names)
reference_period: As in Live Table 600 (LAD24 = 2024 local authority districts)
definition_notes: Built by ta_london.geography.build_boroughs_from_lt600 and written to data/reference/london_boroughs.csv. Names are ONS names; MHCLG tables spell some differently (e.g. '&' for 'and'), so joins use codes only. No inner/outer London flag: not in the source.

title: Temporary accommodation types in London (2002-2025), chart T87, London's Poverty Profile 2026
publisher: Trust for London and WPI Economics (compiled from MHCLG temporary accommodation tables)
reference_period: Calendar years 2002-2025, each an average of 4 quarters
definition_notes: Households in TA by type, with children, in another LA district and duty owed with no accommodation (the last two not counted in the TA total). Source note: 2002-2018 from discontinued MHCLG TA tables, 2019-2025 from live tables, so there is a series break.
notes: CSV download supplied by the user. File name as downloaded.

title: Proportion of households in temporary accommodation in London boroughs (2025 Q4), chart T88, London's Poverty Profile 2026
publisher: Trust for London and WPI Economics (compiled from MHCLG detailed local authority tables)
reference_period: Average of the 4 quarters to 2025 Q4 (calendar 2025)
definition_notes: Households in TA, per 1,000 households, in another LA district, with children, and the matching per-1,000 rates. Counts appear rounded to the nearest 10. Household denominator (000s) is Trust for London's.
notes: CSV download supplied by the user. For London 2025 the pipeline keeps the unrounded T87 values.

title: Council Homes - GLA Housing Starts on Site and Completions, to end of June 2026 (Table 2 by local authority used)
url: not stated in the file; supplied by the user

title: Local Authority Districts (May 2024) Boundaries UK BGC (London boroughs only)
publisher: ONS (Office for National Statistics), Open Geography Portal
definition_notes: Generalised (20m), clipped to the coastline/MHW. Downloaded the 33 features with LAD24CD starting E09 (fields LAD24CD, LAD24NM) as GeoJSON in WGS84 (EPSG:4326). Used only to draw maps; no statistics come from this file.
notes: Query used: https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/Local_Authority_Districts_May_2024_Boundaries_UK_BGC/FeatureServer/0/query with where=LAD24CD LIKE 'E09%', outFields=LAD24CD,LAD24NM, outSR=4326, f=geojson. Licence confirmed 2026-11-10: the ArcGIS item record (f3528c2d6d454edab74f2648cc6a45f6) links to https://www.ons.gov.uk/methodology/geography/licences, which says digital boundary products are supplied under the Open Government Licence and requires 'Source: Office for National Statistics licensed under the Open Government Licence v.3.0' and 'Contains OS data (c) Crown copyright and database right [year]'. The page gives no rule for [year]; we use 2024 (boundary vintage). Shown under every map (app/components.py BOUNDARY_CREDIT).
